qa_cases.question: What are common causes of crash reports?
qa_cases.notes: Should surface issues that mention crashes/freezes; sanity check that retrieval is topically on-target.

qa_cases.question: Are there any issues about settings sync not working across devices?
qa_cases.notes: Tests retrieval on a fairly specific, narrow topic rather than a broad one.

qa_cases.question: What issues mention extensions or plugins failing to load?
qa_cases.notes: Checks the model correctly narrows to extension-related issues, not general bugs.

qa_cases.question: What is the capital of France?
qa_cases.notes: Out-of-domain question — the system prompt tells the model to say when context doesn't answer the question. This checks it doesn't hallucinate an answer from unrelated issues.

triage_cases.title: App crashes on save
triage_cases.body: When I save a large file the app freezes and crashes.
triage_cases.notes: Crash-on-save is a real functionality bug — should not be triaged as low priority.

triage_cases.title: Typo in tooltip text on hover
triage_cases.body: The tooltip says 'recieve' instead of 'receive'. Purely cosmetic.
triage_cases.notes: Trivial cosmetic issue — tests the model doesn't over-prioritize minor issues.

triage_cases.title: Settings Sync does not sync profile associations across machines
triage_cases.body: Same bug as reported before — profile associations are lost when syncing settings between two machines.
triage_cases.notes: Near-exact title match to a real issue already in the dataset (#329754) — checks duplicate detection works at all.
